label: Breast cancer
note: Configurable by the clinical team. The required records are rebuilt from the NCG Essential / Optimal / Optional tiers per setting (NCG breast cancer guidelines 2019, quoted with page on every record), then informed by ICMR, ESMO and the CAP breast biomarker template as before; to be confirmed by the hospital Tumour Board (clinical review before real use).
settings_note: NCG setting of the Case File, chosen by the clinician from what the signed reports record (the system never computes stage). Item 4.1 derives the required records per setting from the NCG tiers.

records.label: Clinical history and performance status

source.quote: All women with a breast lump should undergo a TRIPLE TEST (a)

records.tier_basis: clinical examination is one arm of the triple test

source.quote: a bilateral mammogram (a) and/or Ultrasound (a)/ MRI as appropriate (c)

sources.quote: Histo/cyto pathology confirmation is a MUST before initiating cancer directed treatment

source.quote: Core Biopsy is preferred in cases where neo-adjuvant therapy is planned (for grading and receptor status)

records.label: Receptor status (ER / PR / HER2)

sources.quote: IHC evaluation is mandatory prior to neo adjuvant therapy
Hormone Therapy for all ER &/or PR positive

records.tier_basis: NCG gives no tier letter; every adjuvant arm depends on ER / PR / HER2, so it is treated as Essential (the synoptic form labels IHC (c), B p34)

records.label: Metastatic work-up (chest X-ray, USG abdomen and pelvis; or CECT; bone scan)
records.note: NCG lists X-ray chest, USG abdomen and pelvis and LFT (a); V1 counts this record when any one listed study is present (the LFT is checked under baseline blood tests): check that both the chest and the abdomen and pelvis were imaged (clinical review)

sources.quote: Staging investigations not indicated in cT1-2, N0-1, M0, unless specific symptoms suspicious of metastases
(X-ray Chest, USG abdomen and pelvis, LFT (a) Bone Scan, CECT CHEST /ABDO (b) PETCT(c))

records.tier_basis: metastatic: listed in the NCG metastatic work-up (B p19) without a tier letter; treated as Essential

records.label: CECT chest and abdomen

sources.quote: (X-ray Chest, USG abdomen and pelvis, LFT (a) Bone Scan, CECT CHEST /ABDO (b) PETCT(c))

records.tier_basis: metastatic: listed in the metastatic work-up without a letter; treated as Essential

records.label: Bone scan

sources.quote: (X-ray Chest, USG abdomen and pelvis, LFT (a) Bone Scan, CECT CHEST /ABDO (b) PETCT(c))

records.tier_basis: metastatic: listed in the NCG metastatic work-up (B p19) without a tier letter; treated as Essential
records.note: NCG prints the letter only after LFT; the bone scan is grouped under Metastatic work up (a): kept Optimal for locally advanced disease until clinical review

records.label: Baseline blood tests
records.tier_basis: NCG names LFT (a) for locally advanced disease and routine labs for metastatic disease; not listed for early breast cancer (Optimal there)

post_board.record_fields_source: EUSOMA 2020 (names of all participants, evidence on decisions); Victorian Cancer MDM quality framework 2018 (report errors/changes raised, divergent recommendations and dissenting clinicians); PM-JAY HBP 2.2 s.3.9 (tumour board decision and treatment plan)

core_data.label: Stage as recorded (with the investigations used)

core_data_source: NHS England, Streamlining MDT meetings (2020), p.11 'minimum core data requirements'; aligned with the NCG Virtual Tumour Board case template (India)
policy_basis: PM-JAY Health Benefit Package 2.2 user guidelines (NHA, 2021), section 3.9: pre-authorization is mandatory at each step of cancer care and the decision on appropriate care is to be taken by a multidisciplinary tumour board; NHS England MDT streamlining guidance (2020) pre-listing conditions.
